# shadcn/ui Components

This project uses [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com) as the UI component library.

## About shadcn/ui

shadcn/ui components are located in the `components/ui/` directory and are automatically managed by the shadcn/ui CLI.  
**Please do not edit these files directly** to avoid conflicts with the CLI.

## Available Components

For complete documentation, interactive examples, and usage guidelines, please refer to the official shadcn/ui documentation:

**👉 [shadcn/ui Components Documentation](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components)**

## Project-Specific Components

For custom business components built specifically for this project, please see the **Business Components** section in the sidebar.

## Styling

All shadcn/ui components use:
- **Tailwind CSS** for styling
- **CSS Variables** for theming
- **Radix UI** as the underlying component library

Theme configuration can be found in:
- `app/globals.css` - Global styles and CSS variables
- `tailwind.config.ts` - Tailwind configuration
- `components.json` - shadcn/ui configuration

## Adding New Components

To add a new shadcn/ui component to the project:

```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add [component-name]
```

Example:
```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add command
```

This will automatically install the component in `components/ui/` with the correct configuration.
